info.name: ReqRes App Users API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the ReqRes API. Covers legacy demo endpoints, collections, app-user auth flows, custom endpoints, and the Agent Sandbox (/agent/v1/*) for AI coding agents. All /api/* endpoints require x-api-key. All /app/* endpoints require Authorization: Bearer . /agent/v1/* endpoints are open in v1 (IP-based rate limiting).

Contact Support:
 Name: ReqRes Support
 Email: hello@reqres.in
